name: Question 13
problem: Find the unit tangent vector to the curve $r(t)={t}^{3}p(t)$ at the point corresponding to $t=1$, given that  $p(1)=-2\,i+\,j+\,k\,$ and $\,{p}^{′}(1)=3\,i-3\,j+\,k.$
worked_solution:
For a curve $r(t)=x(t)i+y(t)j+z(t)k$, the unit tangent vector $T(t)$ at the point $P(x(t),y(t),z(t))$ is given by

$$
T(t)=\frac{{r}^{′}(t)}{‖{r}^{′}(t)‖}
$$

First, we find ${r}^{′}(t)$ and evaluate it at $t=1:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({t}^{3}p(t)) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({t}^{3})\cdot p(t)+{t}^{3}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(p(t)) \\  & =3{t}^{2}\,p(t)+{t}^{3}\,{p}^{′}(t) \\ {r}^{′}(1) & =3(1)^{2}\,p(1)+(1)^{3}\,{p}^{′}(1) \\  & =3(-2\,i+\,j+\,k)+(3\,i-3\,j+\,k) \\  & =-6\,i+3\,j+3k+3\,i-3\,j+\,k \\  & =-3\,i+4\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we calculate the magnitude of ${r}^{′}(1):$  

$$
\begin{aligned}‖r(1)‖ & =\sqrt{(-3)^{2}+(0)^{2}+(4)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{25} \\  & =5\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we normalize ${r}^{′}(1):$  

$$
\begin{aligned}T(1) & =\frac{{r}^{′}(1)}{‖{r}^{′}(1)‖} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}\cdot (-3\,i+4\,k) \\  & =-\frac{3}{5}\,i+\frac{4}{5}\,k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the unit tangent vector to the curve at the point that corresponds to $t=1$ is  $T(1)=-\frac{3}{5}\,i+\frac{4}{5}\,k.$

Question 13
?

Find the unit tangent vector to the curve r(t)=t3p(t) at the point corresponding to t=1, given that p(1)=−2i+j+k and p′(1)=3i−3j+k.

a
−35i+45k
b
−22i+12j+12k
c
−225i+15j+45k
d
−12i+32j
e
−35j+25k
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

For a curve r(t)=x(t)i+y(t)j+z(t)k, the unit tangent vector T(t) at the point P(x(t),y(t),z(t)) is given by T(t)=r′(t)‖r′(t)‖

First, we find r′(t) and evaluate it at t=1:

r′(t)=ddt(t3p(t))=ddt(t3)⋅p(t)+t3⋅ddt(p(t))=3t2p(t)+t3p′(t)r′(1)=3(1)2p(1)+(1)3p′(1)=3(−2i+j+k)+(3i−3j+k)=−6i+3j+3k+3i−3j+k=−3i+4k

Now, we calculate the magnitude of r′(1):

‖r(1)‖=(−3)2+(0)2+(4)2=25=5

Finally, we normalize r′(1):

T(1)=r′(1)‖r′(1)‖=15⋅(−3i+4k)=−35i+45k

Therefore, the unit tangent vector to the curve at the point that corresponds to t=1 is T(1)=−35i+45k.
